metadata.modeling_rule: Record only speaker-specific positions directly supported by the archived caption turn and an explicit named handoff or immediate speaker transition. Panel participation does not imply agreement.
metadata.identity_rule: Names are preserved as stated by the first-party video metadata. This dataset does not create or relax person-identity matches.
metadata.copyright_boundary: No continuous transcript is reproduced; only timestamps and bounded factual paraphrases are retained.
